headline: Software sector rotation into AI names lifts Workday
detail: WDAY jumped ~10% in one late-July session and rose ~5.2% on Jul 29 as investors rotated out of high-flying semiconductors into beaten-down software stocks amid renewed AI enthusiasm; no company-specific announcement drove the move.

headline: Q2 2026 earnings beat on accelerating cloud growth
detail: SAP reported Q2 EPS of $2.15 (vs $2.00 est) and cloud revenue up 24% to $7.1B, with cloud backlog up 26% YoY to $26.06B; shares rallied ~7% on Jul 24 and added more as guidance was reaffirmed.

headline: Weak Q2 preview: net loss guidance and negative margins
detail: T1 Energy's preliminary Q2 showed revenue of $245M-$255M but a net loss of $34M-$37M plus heavy cash burn (>$130M FCF outflow); shares fell ~12.8% on Jul 28, extending a steep monthly slide.

headline: Q2 2026 earnings miss with widening losses
detail: Comstock reported Q2 revenue of ~$1.38M (below ~$1.48M consensus) and EPS of -$0.12, with operating loss widening to $26.9M and net loss of $25.5M; shares fell sharply around the Jul 23 report.

headline: Memory-sector selloff and pre-earnings profit-taking
detail: Sandisk unwound its huge 2026 run, down ~55% in July, as the AI-memory trade faded on fears memory price increases could slow and investors de-risked ahead of the Aug 5 earnings report; no fresh company-specific bad news.

headline: AI/optical sector selloff despite strong fundamentals
detail: Coherent fell ~9-11% in late July amid a sector-wide selloff in optical/AI-connectivity names (triggered partly by Corning's earnings) as traders questioned AI capex durability, even though COHR posted record ~$1.8B revenue (+21%) and raised its outlook.

headline: Profit-taking in optical/AI stocks after huge run-up
detail: Applied Optoelectronics dropped ~13% on Jul 28 as part of a broad selloff in optical and AI-connectivity names, with traders reassessing AI infrastructure spending; the stock was vulnerable after a +342% one-year run, not a company-specific event.

headline: Cut preliminary Q2 revenue and margin guidance
detail: ADTRAN lowered preliminary Q2 revenue to $280M-$282M (below ~$293M consensus) and slashed non-GAAP operating margin outlook to 3.5%-4.0% from 5%-9%, citing a delayed major customer project and elevated component/freight costs; shares fell ~14-20% on volume up 255%.

headline: Short squeeze plus institutional buying off all-time lows
detail: Figma jumped ~11.9% on Jul 13 in what looked like a short squeeze (42.4% of float sold short) after an SEC filing showed Citizens Financial Group bought over 162,000 shares; earlier July gains followed a bullish Citi initiation.

headline: Q2 earnings beat and raised 2026 revenue outlook
detail: Oatly reported Q2 revenue of $240.1M (+15.2%), gross margin up to 33.9%, a narrower net loss and slightly positive adjusted EBITDA, and raised FY2026 constant-currency growth guidance to 8%-10% from 3%-5%; shares surged ~29% then added ~17% more.

headline: New EV SUV launches and CXMT chipmaker debut
detail: Xiaomi rose as much as 7.7% on Jul 27 (highest since June 3) on the unveiling of two new SUVs (SkyNomad N90 Max and N70 Max) and enthusiasm over Xiaomi-backed memory chipmaker CXMT, which soared over 500% on its trading debut.

headline: Neocloud selloff and asset-light model concerns
detail: Nebius fell ~14% (down ~28% over 30 days from its June peak) as the 'neocloud' AI-datacenter trade unwound; a new asset-light infrastructure model raised concerns about cost of capital vs returns, compounded by insider selling and sector pressure.

headline: Wells Fargo price-target hike to $500 on AI momentum
detail: Snowflake hit a new 52-week high (~$282.90) after Wells Fargo maintained Overweight and raised its target to $500 from $320, calling it a near-term AI beneficiary; strong uptake of AI products like Cortex Code (4,400+ customers) reinforced the rally.

headline: Semiconductor selloff and insider-selling momentum unwind
detail: AXT fell ~12.7% (down ~50% over 30 days) in a sharp momentum unwind after running from ~$2 to a $143 high in late May; heavy insider selling by the CEO and directors, valuation concerns and a chip-sector pullback drove the drop ahead of Jul 30 earnings.

headline: Record June exports and strategic moves fuel recovery
detail: BYD rallied (~9% around Jul 2, up ~22% for the month) on record June overseas exports (+94.7% to 175,349 units) partly offsetting weak domestic sales, plus strategic hires including former Hungarian FM Peter Szijjarto joining Jul 15 to lead external relations.

headline: Q2 earnings blowout, raised guidance, and Mizuho upgrade
detail: Bloom Energy reported Jul 28 Q2 EPS of $0.78 (vs $0.39 est) on revenue of $1.07B (vs ~$826M est) and raised 2026 guidance to $3.9B-$4.2B revenue; shares jumped ~27% on Jul 30 after Mizuho upgraded to Buy on AI power-demand deals, driving volume ~120% above average.
